Status: **released**. Release reference: **Harbor-OCT-6-fcee4c43e6342a2c**. Source revision: close-10-01; dispatch plan revision: 6. Delivered items: summary, detail, exceptions and reconciliation. All four reports were submitted with the SR-4-01 source-routing receipt, verified against the source, and processed; all dispatch entries are completed. The release check reported ready, with 3 of 3 policy checks passed. The customer descriptor identifies Harbor's October pack and close-10-01.

Processing used: four slots, two from Harbor (summary and detail) and two from shared operations-reporting (exceptions and reconciliation). At the last desk read, shared usage was four of 14 slots across accounts; ten remained, including capacity for eight scheduled operations reports. Processing already performed remains charged to the window.

Outstanding source findings: four pending commitments (HAR-003, HAR-009, HAR-015, HAR-021); five late completions (HAR-002, HAR-007, HAR-012, HAR-017, HAR-022); and three completed commitments without current acceptance evidence (HAR-004, HAR-011, HAR-018). Seven commitments lack matching current acceptance receipts in total. These are reported findings, not missing pack items.

December processing credits depend on current October releases for all accounts across both desks.
